blocks.title: Set up and run untrusted checks locally
blocks.code:
git submodule update --init execution-specs ethereum-tests
zig build unit && zig build test-trace
bun .smithers/scripts/run-trusted-ci.ts --untrusted ci '//...'
uphill --compact

blocks.title: Connect your agent via Smithers Cloud MCP
blocks.code:
claude mcp add guillotine-mini --transport http https://smithers.sh/evmts/guillotine-mini/mcp
codex mcp add guillotine-mini --url https://smithers.sh/evmts/guillotine-mini/mcp
agy mcp add guillotine-mini --transport http https://smithers.sh/evmts/guillotine-mini/mcp

cards.title: Run untrusted locally
cards.text: Contributors are encouraged to run tests, flows, and Lighthouse audits locally with read-only cache access.

cards.title: Trusted merge gates
cards.text: Only Smithers-controlled sandboxes and maintainers write the shared cache or satisfy merge gates.

cards.title: Spec-first evidence
cards.text: Cite the Python execution-specs line and include a minimal failing regression before writing a fix.

cards.title: Person-only merge
cards.text: Agents reproduce, review, and report backpressure. Only a human maintainer approves and lands to main.

blocks.title: Guillotine Mini
blocks.tagline: A minimal, spec-first Ethereum Virtual Machine in Zig, built publicly on Smithers Cloud.
blocks.text: Frontier through Osaka with Glamsterdam hooks, a 42-symbol C ABI, a WASI Preview 1 WebAssembly reactor with linked Rust crypto, and an executable Lean 4 differential oracle.

cards.title: Spec-first parity
cards.text: Gas ordering, hardfork guards, and error mapping follow Python execution-specs line by line.

cards.title: Zero-overhead inspection
cards.text: 15-hook Inspector vtable, 256-bit OpcodeMask filtering, 6 native tracers, and EIP-3155 JSONL traces.

cards.title: Lean 4 formal oracle

cards.title: Portable C and WASM ABI
